remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom condo offering the perfect blend of space, style, and convenience. Located in a highly desirable community with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, this home places you just minutes from shopping, dining, entertainment, and more. Step inside to an open and inviting floor plan, where the kitchen, living, and dining areas flow seamlessly-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Hardwood floors grace the entire main level, enhancing the natural light that fills the space. Upstairs, you'll find a large primary suite with a balcony and full bath, a generously sized second bedroom, a full bath, and a versatile loft-perfect as a home office, reading nook, or play area. The lower level features a spacious family room offering additional living space, along with plenty of storage to keep things organized and out of sight. With its functional layout, modern comforts, and unbeatable location, this condo is a true find for those seeking low-maintenance living without sacrificing space or style.
